description: A Flutter application's main.dart file that defines the app's structure, routing, webview-based HTML asset loading, and diagnostics features.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app that manages routing and asset mapping.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: A widget that displays the list of available generated screens for navigation.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Widget wrapping a WebView to display a local HTML asset.

classes.name: _WebViewContainer
classes.description: Internal widget that initializes and controls the WebView based on the parent HtmlAssetScreen.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: A widget that loads, prepares, and displays an HTML asset in a WebView, with handling for injecting base href, CSS, and error fallbacks.

classes.name: DiagnosticsScreen
classes.description: A screen that performs diagnostics by checking referenced assets' existence.

classes.name: _CheckResult
classes.description: Helper class representing the result of each asset check in diagnostics.

classes.name: UnknownRouteScreen
classes.description: A simple screen displayed for unknown routes (404).

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that ensures Flutter bindings are initialized and runs the app.
